<!-- Generated by docs-infra Python API -->

```python
dim(name_or_int: Union[str, int, Dim]) -> Dim
```

Part of [`evoxc.core`](/api/evoxc/core/)

Create a `Dim` from a name, a known size, or a `Dim`.

## Parameters

- `name_or_int` · `Union[str, int, Dim]` — If a string, a named symbolic dimension with unknown
  size. If an int `n`, an anonymous dimension named `f"dim_{n}"`
  with known size `n` (deterministic name — equal ints produce
  equal dims, and the known size makes evaluation exact). If a
  `Dim`, returned unchanged.

## Returns

- `Dim` — The `Dim`.

## Raises

- `TypeError` — If the argument is not a str, int or Dim.
